ANNOUNCEMENTS.title: Bloomberg Terminal access extended
ANNOUNCEMENTS.body: Great news — the library has extended Bloomberg Terminal hours to 10 PM on weekdays for club members. Show your student ID and mention Finance Club.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.author: Alex Chen · President

ANNOUNCEMENTS.title: Stock Pitch Competition — team sign-ups open
ANNOUNCEMENTS.body: Teams of 2–3. Sign up by Sep 3 to secure your slot. Top 3 teams present to a panel of alumni judges. Cash prizes for 1st and 2nd place.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.author: Maya Patel · VP Events

ANNOUNCEMENTS.title: Welcome back, Fall 2026!
ANNOUNCEMENTS.body: Kick-off meeting is Sep 5 at 6 PM in LaCava 220. Come meet the new exec board, hear about this semester's events, and grab some free merch.
ANNOUNCEMENTS.author: Alex Chen · President
